errors.text_span: The slices are arranged in descending order by size in a counter-clockwise direction starting from the top.
errors.evidence: The pie slices are not arranged in descending order counter-clockwise; the chart shows 2019 (blue) at the top, 2018 (orange) on the left/bottom-left, and 2017 (green) on the right/bottom-right, not a clear descending counter-clockwise sequence.

errors.text_span: Optisch sind die Segmente im Uhrzeigersinn, beginnend in der oberen Hälfte, nach absteigender Größe angeordnet.
errors.evidence: The chart does not show the slices ordered by descending size around the circle; it simply shows the three year slices in their positions. This is an added structural claim not supported by the figure.
For a pie chart there are no axes to describe, so this is not an issue.
